description: The KNMI Data Platform is the Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute's service for delivering its datasets by programme. The developer portal read on 2026-09-28 documents a file-based Open Data API that lists and queries the files of each dataset and creates download links, a Notification Service that announces each new file, an Environmental Data Retrieval (EDR) API, a WMS API for maps and a Dataset Content API; many files are NetCDF. Every call needs an API key: a shared anonymous key published in the documentation and valid until August 2027, with 3,000 requests an hour shared among all users, a registered key after signing up with 1,000 requests an hour, and a bulk key for whole datasets. Coverage is the Netherlands, for the datasets KNMI publishes on the platform. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC0-1.0 unless otherwise stated (KNMI copyright page); dataset-specific terms on the data platform. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the dataset catalogue page refused the cloud session (403, then 429), so the list of datasets and their periods was not read, and the anonymous key's quota is shared. It supports hazard and adaptation studies, such as pulling radar rainfall or wind observations to drive flood or storm impact models for Dutch infrastructure. No related KNMI data record is catalogued.
